title: Sources and telecoms data: a coordinated campaign of SS7 pings was used to track the locations of US personnel during the US-led strikes on Iran in February (Financial Times)
summary: Financial Times: Sources and telecoms data: a coordinated campaign of SS7 pings was used to track the locations of US personnel during the US-led strikes on Iran in February — Roaming systems and ad tech were used to try to locate American personnel as Tehran attacked forces in the region
